classes.DETERMINISTIC: one known frame, one target frame; the difficulty is carried by vocabulary
classes.SPLIT: one known frame, two or more target frames chosen by a trigger; the difficulty is in the frame
classes.INVERSION: the shape mirrors — constituent order reorganises (verb-final, prenominal relative, dative inversion)
classes.ERASURE: the target is simpler and drops a distinction the known side marks

spa_for_eng.mapping: want to VP → quiero + inf; want SUBJ2 to VP → quiero que + SUBJUNCTIVE
spa_for_eng.note: subject-switch is the trigger; seeds 1 and 15 are the deliberate minimal pair

deu_for_eng.mapping: want SUBJ2 to VP → dass-clause with verb final — BUT seed 15 does not do it: 'ich will morgen mit dir Deutsch sprechen' drops the embedded subject entirely
deu_for_eng.note: the seed-15 fidelity flag, confirmed live

zho_for_eng.mapping: 想 + bare clause, no complementiser: 我也想你明天和我说中文

jpn_for_eng.mapping: 〜たい is subject-bound, so the embedded subject is dropped: 明日も一緒に日本語を話したい

spa_for_eng.mapping: going to VP → ir a + inf
progressive → estar + gerundio | plain present
spa_for_eng.note: ongoing-at-this-moment keeps estar+gerundio; embedded/habitual collapses to the simple present (140 'you're trying' → intentas)

spa_for_eng.mapping: can/could → puedo / pueda / podía / pudo / podría
spa_for_eng.note: four target outcomes under one English modal; 310-318 drill the block, 148/433 are the only pudo/pude preterites

spa_for_eng.mapping: be able to → poder (same verb as 'can')
spa_for_eng.note: the known side's can / be able to distinction has no target trace

spa_for_eng.mapping: have to / need to → tener que / necesitar / hay que, plus tuve que vs tenga que
should → debería (conditional of deber)
must → tener que; might → podría | puede que + SUBJUNCTIVE

jpn_for_eng.mapping: negative-conditional periphrasis: 学ばないといけない ('if I don't learn it won't do')

spa_for_eng.mapping: think that CLAUSE → pienso que + INDICATIVE; negated → no pienso que + SUBJUNCTIVE
spa_for_eng.note: negation of the matrix verb is the trigger; 325/326 are the minimal pair

deu_for_eng.mapping: denken, dass + VERB-FINAL: Ich denke, dass er sich hinsetzen will

zho_for_eng.mapping: 觉得 + bare clause, same order as English

jpn_for_eng.mapping: clause first, matrix verb last: 彼は座りたいんだと思う

spa_for_eng.mapping: know → saber (fact) | conocer (person/place)
spa_for_eng.note: no English trace at all; the split is lexical and invisible on the known side

spa_for_eng.mapping: hope → espero + inf; subject-switch → espero que + SUBJUNCTIVE
spa_for_eng.note: adjacent seeds — the authors put the minimal pair side by side

spa_for_eng.mapping: say/tell → decir (+ obligatory dative clitic me/le/te) | contar
spa_for_eng.note: 'nobody told me' → nadie me dijo: the clitic is minted, not translated

spa_for_eng.mapping: before → antes de que + SUBJUNCTIVE | antes de + inf; after → después de (que)
spa_for_eng.note: 110 (same subject, infinitive) vs 25 (subject switch, subjunctive)

zho_for_eng.mapping: temporal clause precedes the main clause; 之后/时 are clause-FINAL: 你说完之后我也能说

jpn_for_eng.mapping: まで/うちに clause-final and pre-matrix: 終わるまで知りたくない

spa_for_eng.mapping: if → si + present (real) | si + IMPERFECT SUBJUNCTIVE (hypothetical)
spa_for_eng.note: realis/irrealis; English 'if' carries the trigger only in the tense of its own clause

spa_for_eng.mapping: because/but/although → porque/pero/aunque
spa_for_eng.note: aunque can take the subjunctive; not attested in the seeds

spa_for_eng.mapping: relative clause → que + INDICATIVE (specific) | que + SUBJUNCTIVE (non-specific)
spa_for_eng.note: 22 'people who speak Spanish' (hablan) vs 297 'many people who speak Spanish' under negation (hablen)

deu_for_eng.mapping: relative clause postnominal but verb-final: Leute treffen will, die Deutsch sprechen

zho_for_eng.mapping: PRENOMINAL relative with 的: 会说中文的人
zho_for_eng.note: the shape mirrors

jpn_for_eng.mapping: prenominal, no relative pronoun: 日本語を話す人

spa_for_eng.mapping: 'd have VPpp → habría + participle; 'd VPpp → hubiera/hubieras + participle
spa_for_eng.note: THE double-'d split: one English contraction, two Spanish moods. The whole teaching job of seed 600.

deu_for_eng.mapping: hätte + participle, wenn-clause verb-final: wenn du mir gesagt hättest

zho_for_eng.mapping: no counterfactual marking at all: 如果你告诉我…我会开车的 — the double-'d split disappears
zho_for_eng.note: this is the reverse frame-ZUT case: eng_for_zho learners must mint what their known side never marks

jpn_for_eng.mapping: 〜てくれてたら + plain past; no dedicated counterfactual: 疲れてるって言ってくれてたら運転した

spa_for_eng.mapping: it's ADJ → es (property) | está (state/location)
spa_for_eng.note: ser/estar; no English trace

spa_for_eng.mapping: there is / there are → hay (invariant)
spa_for_eng.note: number agreement on the known side is erased in the target

zho_for_eng.mapping: location-first existential: 我脑子里有太多想法

jpn_for_eng.mapping: location-first with 多すぎる: 頭の中に考えが多すぎる

spa_for_eng.mapping: do-support → nothing; question = intonation + ¿ ?
spa_for_eng.note: the English auxiliary has no target correspondent

deu_for_eng.mapping: no do-support; V2 inversion carries the question: sprichst du…?

zho_for_eng.note: new admission: the 吗 particle itself

spa_for_eng.mapping: wh-word → qué/cómo/dónde/cuándo/quién/por qué + inverted verb
embedded question → lo que (free relative) | si (whether) | qué (interrogative)
not/n't → no before the verb; negative concord (no ... nada/nadie)
than → que (phrase) | de lo que (clause)
spa_for_eng.note: 117 'better than last time' (que) vs 118 'better than I felt' (de lo que)

spa_for_eng.mapping: as ADJ as possible → lo más ADJ posible
spa_for_eng.note: the shape reorganises: superlative frame replaces the equative frame

spa_for_eng.mapping: let's VP → hortative SUBJUNCTIVE (hablemos)
spa_for_eng.note: mints subjunctive morphology with no known-side trace

spa_for_eng.mapping: what's it like → cómo es; it's like this → es así
time adverbs map one-to-one and sit clause-finally
have VPpp → he + participle | llevo + gerundio (duration) | me queda (possession-left)
spa_for_eng.note: three target frames under one English perfect
no be-passive found on the English known side of these 668 seeds

spa_for_eng.mapping: SUBJ likes X → a SUBJ le gusta X (experiencer to dative, theme to subject)
spa_for_eng.note: the canonical inversion of the pair

deu_for_eng.mapping: gern + verb, no inversion: meine Mutter liest gern
deu_for_eng.note: contrast with spa's dative inversion

jpn_for_eng.mapping: nominalised complement + 好き: 読むのが好き
